name: recurring_and_one_off_notifications
description: One message carrying two different notifications: a recurring weekly digest to every participant, and a one-off reminder to a single person resolved by name. Forces get_project_contacts and resolve_person in the same plan, with different recipients.

turns.message: Todos los lunes a las 9 de la manana mandale por WhatsApp a los participantes de Farmacia Haussman un resumen de lo que tienen pendiente, y aparte hoy mandale a Maria un recordatorio de la tarea de formulacion magistral
turns.why: Two sends, two audiences, one recurring. Both go to third parties, so turn 1 proposes and states the schedule as it understood it.

assert.comment: The last pattern: no phone number may appear in a turn that has not read contacts. A number in the reply here means the model wrote one.

turns.why: Both notifications go out; the recurring one carries recurring_days.
